xna-type.name: ModelBoneCollection
xna-type.summary: Represents a set of bones associated with a model.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Retrieves a ModelBone from the collection, given the name of the bone.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Returns a ModelBoneCollection.Enumerator that can iterate through a ModelBoneCollection.

overload.summary: Returns a ModelBoneCollection.Enumerator that can iterate through a ModelBoneCollection.
overload.returns: The ModelBoneCollection.Enumerator of the bone collection.

method.name: TryGetValue
method.summary: Finds a bone with a given name if it exists in the collection.

overload.summary: Finds a bone with a given name if it exists in the collection.

parameters.parameter: The name of the bone to find.
[ OutAttribute ] The bone named boneName , if found.

overload.returns: true if the named bone is found, otherwise false.
